Today we’re checking out the One Man’s Trash Add On by SystemZee’s Workshop for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. This add on introduces a living trash can that can eat your unwanted junk and turn it into something more valuable. It also adds flies with pollinating abilities, bonus trash bags with unique qualities and plenty of configuration options to mess around with.
